subject: Pilot commercial gates + PO timing — next steps and internal approvals map
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot commercial gates + PO timing — recap and next steps

Hi Priya / Tim — thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned on commercial gates and procurement timing.

Summary from our discussion:
- Pilot scope: 2 production integrations (chat support + knowledge retrieval) running on Redwood hosted instances. Expected peak token mix ~50% prompt / 50% completion.
- Target throughput: ~7M tokens/month initial, scaling to ~20M over 3 months depending on model mix.
- Target unit economics: client asked for a target in the ballpark of $900–1200 per 1M tokens for the pilot (we discussed options to tighten with batching & caching).
- Procurement constraints: Acme requires PO for monthly commitments > $10k and vendor onboarding takes ~10 business days once legal & PO are aligned.

Proposed commercial gate and procurement plan (please confirm):
1) Pilot commitment band: $6k–$24k / month (7M–20M tokens). We recommend aiming for the middle band ($12k/mo) to keep runway for scale.
2) Discounting / credits: we can offer a pilot credit tranche (one-time $5k) for a 3-month pilot if Acme signs a 3-month commitment. Karthik, is that within standard pilot credit allowance?
3) PO timing: if Acme intends to use a PO, legal & finance will need the SOW + pricing table to start onboarding. Target lead time: 7–12 business days after receiving the PO request.

Attachments: I’ve attached the pricing breakdown per 1M tokens and a sample MAP/MAT that maps token volume to price band.

Next steps:
- Priya: let us know preferred pilot monthly band and if legal needs a redline copy of SOW by EOD Friday.
- Tim: confirm whether procurement will provide a PO or prefer invoice-first approach.
- Jordan + Karthik: if the pilot credit plan above needs adjustment, can you confirm internal approval path and delegation?

Thanks — I’ll schedule a short follow-up (15m) early next week to lock the band and PO timeline.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(h) +1 415-555-0192 | hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference — production LLM inference for engineering teams

Attachments:

- proposed-MAP-MAT.xlsx (xlsx, 1 sheet)

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Evans <t.evans@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot commercial gates + PO timing — recap and next steps

Thanks Hannah — clear recap. A few clarifications from procurement on our side:

- The $900–1200 / 1M target is a little optimistic for the initial SOW; finance is expecting ~ $1,300 / 1M as a conservative estimate given our current usage patterns. Can you provide an explicit effective rate table that shows blended $/1M for the 7M and 20M buckets (with and without pilot credit)?
- PO thresholds: our policy is any vendor spend > $15k/month requires VP sign-off and a 30-day invoice net term. Anything <= $15k/mo can be handled by team-level PO.
- Legal will want the SOW redline; please send the SOW PDF rather than a live doc.

Also: can Redwood confirm whether prefix caching and batching metrics are instrumented for billing reconciliation? We need token-level usage logs for audit.

If you can get the rate table and SOW PDF by EOD tomorrow we can aim to route this through procurement next week.

— Priya
Priya Shah | Director, IT Procurement | Acme Health
priya.shah@acmehealth.com

Thanks Priya — great questions. Quick answers and an updated ask: 

1) Blended rate table: attached in the updated pricing PDF — shows effective $/1M for 7M and 20M monthly bands with three scenarios: list price, pilot credit ($5k one-time applied over 3 months), and enhanced batching (estimated 8% token reduction).
2) Billing & logs: Redwood provides token-level usage reports exportable as CSV and a secure billing dashboard access for reconciliation; we can share a sample CSV that includes prefix/cache deltas for audit.
3) PO thresholds & terms: noted — I’ve flagged the $15k threshold. If Acme picks the middle band (~$12k) we can operate under team-level PO; if they prefer to lock in $18k+/mo we’ll plan for VP sign-off and 30-day terms.

Jordan/Karthik/LAUREN: can one of you confirm whether we can extend the standard pilot credit to $5k for this account and approving sign-off path if we cross $15k/month? Ideally we’d like a delegated approval for pilot credit (sales manager) and an escalation path if finance needs to own discounts > $X.

Action items I’ll complete by EOD:
- Upload SOW PDF (redline-ready) to the HubSpot deal and share link to procurement.
- Attach the updated pricing table showing blended effective $/1M.

Hannah

Attachments:

Hannah — quick internal confirmation: 

- Pilot credit: approved up to $5k as a one-time incentive for a 3-month committed pilot. Sales manager can sign off.
- Discount delegation: any list-price reduction up to 12% can be handled by the sales manager; deeper discounts require Finance/RevOps sign-off (Lauren).
- >$15k/mo escalation: Finance will require VP approval for contractual net-30; operationally we can start onboarding with a team-level PO but will need VP countersignature before moving to longer-term commitments.

Karthik: can you drop the standard SOW template redline in the HubSpot deal so Hannah can attach per Priya’s ask? Lauren: FYI on potential net-30 ask — will you pre-clear the revops channel?

Jordan
